title: 第0005章 引气入体丹田神秘空间第0006章 人心如刀指定任务
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间

;;
陆青禾回到自己的院落，就沉沉的睡去了，直到第二天听到王山焦急的声音，陆青禾才快速起身。
才走出院落，王山拉着陆青禾朝着前面跑去。
“你还真能睡，刘洪师兄马上要传授我们修炼之法，错过了就亏大了。”
陆青禾才想起来昨天刘洪师兄说的要给他们识字和讲解修炼之道的。
陆青禾有些不好意思，他只是好久没有这样好好休息，一时间放松精神，才差点睡过头忘了大事。
等到两人到了讲道的到场，已经有数十名孩童坐在这里等待着。
王山和陆青禾也找了个位置坐了进去。
越来越多的孩童陆续出现，将整个道场坐得满当当的。
不多时刘洪一身白衣的出现在道场上，坐在最前面的蒲团上。
刘洪开口：“太玄宗，建宗三千载，现弟子数千，筑基真人三十二人，还有三尊金丹老祖坐镇。
是赵国三大仙宗之一，一言一行都可以决定亿万黎明的命运。”
“尔等为太玄宗杂役弟子，可获得三层炼气法诀，这些都在你们院落的石桌玉简上。”
“现在我就给你们讲修炼第一境炼气境。”
全部人立刻聚精会神，生怕听少一个字，这可是关乎他们能不能成为仙人的关键。
“炼气境，引气入体，打通穴窍，淬炼肉身与神魂。”
“修仙者必定具备灵根，只有灵根才能够亲和天地灵气，没有灵根就无法修炼。
同样的灵根越好，修炼的速度越快，比如单灵根，对天地灵气亲合度高，能够简单的完成引气入体，如此也被称为天灵根。
次之是双灵根，因为是两种灵根，灵气亲合度减半，修炼效率只有天灵根的一半。
然后是三灵根，三种灵根的修炼效率是二灵根的一半，四灵根再次减半，五灵根同样的道理。”

陆青禾暗自心惊，这样推算，五灵根的修炼速度是四灵根的一半，是三灵根的四分之一，是二灵根的八分之一。
相比起天灵根，是十六倍的差距。
全部人脸色都不好，他们没有想到他们和那些灵根好的差距如此之大。
坐在这里的大多是四灵根，还有少数如同陆青禾这样的五灵根。
刘洪看大家难看的脸色，也猜的七七八八：“你们也没有必要灰心，修炼快慢灵根只是一个方面。
修炼讲的是“财侣法地”，比如灵石和丹药都可以加快你们修炼速度。
等到你们完成引气入体，就可以去接宗门任务，获得修炼资源，加快修炼速度。”
“好了，现在就传授你们如何完成引气入体。”
刘洪开始讲解引气入体的诀窍，全部人听得滋滋有味。
接下来的半年时间，刘洪每天都按时出现给大家识文断字，还有传授修炼之法。
一晃转眼就是八个月的时间过去。
陆青禾端坐在蒲团上，石桌上的玉简记录的是修炼功法【云霁练气诀】前三层的修炼之法。
想要获得后面的修炼功法，只有境界达到炼气三层，成为外门弟子才能够获得。

Lu Qinghe returned to his courtyard and fell into a deep sleep. It wasn't until he heard Wang Shan's anxious voice the next day that Lu Qinghe got up quickly.
After walking out of the courtyard, Wang Shan pulled Lu Qinghe and ran forward.
"You can really sleep. Senior Brother Liu Hong is going to teach us the cultivation method soon. If we miss it, we will suffer a big loss."
Only then did Lu Qinghe remember what Senior Brother Liu Hong had said yesterday that he would teach them how to read and practice cultivation.
Lu Qinghe was a little embarrassed. He just hadn't had such a good rest for a long time. He relaxed for a while and almost overslept and forgot about important things.
When the two arrived at the sermon, dozens of children were already sitting here waiting.
Wang Shan and Lu Qinghe also found a seat and sat in.
More and more children appeared one after another, filling the entire dojo.
Not long after, Liu Hong appeared in the dojo dressed in white and sat on the futon at the front.
Liu Hong said: "Tai Xuan Zong has been established for three thousand years, and now has thousands of disciples, thirty-two foundation masters, and three golden elixir ancestors sitting in charge.
He is one of the three great immortal sects in the Zhao Kingdom, and his words and deeds can determine the fate of hundreds of millions of dawns. "
"As the disciples of the Taixuan Sect's servants, you can obtain three levels of Qi refining techniques. These are all on the stone table and jade slips in your courtyard."
"Now I will tell you about the first stage of cultivation, the Qi Refining Stage."
Everyone immediately concentrated their attention, fearing that they would miss a word, which was the key to whether they could become immortals.
"The Qi Refining Realm introduces Qi into the body, opens the acupoints, and tempers the body and soul."
"A cultivator must have spiritual roots. Only spiritual roots can be in harmony with the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. Without spiritual roots, cultivation is impossible.
The better the same spiritual root, the faster the cultivation speed. For example, a single spiritual root has a high affinity to the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and can simply introduce the energy into the body. This is also called a heavenly spiritual root.
The second is the double spiritual root. Because there are two spiritual roots, the affinity of the spiritual energy is halved, and the cultivation efficiency is only half that of the Tianling root.
Then there are the three spiritual roots. The cultivation efficiency of the three spiritual roots is half that of the second spiritual root. The fourth spiritual root is half as much again. The same is true for the five spiritual roots. "
Lu Qinghe was secretly shocked. According to this calculation, the cultivation speed of the Five Spiritual Roots was half that of the Four Spiritual Roots, one-fourth that of the Three Spiritual Roots, and one-eighth that of the Two Spiritual Roots.
Compared to Tianlinggen, there is a gap of sixteen times.
Everyone looked bad. They didn't expect that there was such a big gap between them and those with good spiritual roots.
Most of the people sitting here have four spiritual roots, and a few have five spiritual roots like Lu Qinghe.
Liu Hong looked at everyone's ugly faces and guessed: "There is no need for you to be discouraged. Cultivation of the speed and slowness of spiritual roots is only one aspect.
Cultivation is about "the land of wealth lovers". For example, spiritual stones and elixirs can speed up your practice.
Once you have completed introducing the Qi into your body, you can take on sect missions, obtain cultivation resources, and speed up your cultivation. "
"Okay, now I will teach you how to complete the introduction of Qi into the body."
Liu Hong began to explain the secret of introducing Qi into the body, and everyone listened with interest.
For the next six months, Liu Hong showed up on time every day to teach everyone how to read and write, and also taught them how to practice cultivation.
Eight months passed in the blink of an eye.
Lu Qinghe was sitting on the futon. The jade slips on the stone table recorded the first three levels of the cultivation method [Yunji Qi Lian Jue].
If you want to obtain the subsequent cultivation techniques, you can only obtain them if you reach the third level of Qi Refining and become an outer disciple.
